extent of text rendering beyond the template's 'CHROMA1-HD' title demo: NOT FOUND

selection.why: the official template: fp8mixed HD, full CFG with an effective negative prompt, 26 steps beta; the pick when the user wants Flux-class photographic/artistic/anime output with real negatives and an unfiltered model
same graph, bf16 17.8 GB file (+ t5xxl_fp16 recommended when memory allows)

selection.tradeoff: 8 steps at cfg 1 (3x fewer steps, no negative); settings are community-confirmed, not documented by the publisher
pixel-space model, 'reduced artifacts and distortion' per the template blurb but officially WIP with 'squiggles' in details; 19 GB; no VAE

params.name: steps
params.interactions: Flash with many steps wastes the distillation

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: full classifier-free guidance; Chroma honours the negative prompt
params.interactions: Flash: cfg 1-1.5 (baked); HD: very high cfg with shift 1 hurts

params.name: shift
params.meaning: flow shift; 'Flow Shift node set to 1.0 represents intended shift by the creator of the Chroma model and will produce greater detail'

official_reference_code.radiance note: 'can be raised up to 3.0 in order to help with complex compositions'

params.interactions: node default 1.73 is not the creator's value; raising shift trades detail for composition

params.name: scheduler
params.meaning: beta schedule in every official graph

params.name: width / height
params.meaning: multiples of 16 (both nodes step 16); HD/Base/Flash latent is Flux-type /8, Radiance works in pixels

params.name: min_padding / min_length
params.meaning: T5 padding-token masking ('Unmask just one padding token while masking the rest')
params.interactions: 'min_padding 1 is the official way. setting it to 0 works too. might vary depending on t5 variant'; community: 'no big difference'

params.name: nerf_tile_size
params.meaning: Radiance NeRF decoder tiling: -1 = default 32, 0 = no tiling
params.interactions: 'as large as possible until you run out of GPU memory if you want increased speed'; 0 'may require a lot of VRAM'; force_sequential_txt_ids only for 2026-05-22..06-01 checkpoints lacking __sequential__

rules.message: Chroma uses ONLY T5-XXL: CLIPLoader with type 'chroma' (ComfyUI clip_target = PixArt-style T5 encoder). DualCLIPLoader type flux with clip_l is the Flux habit and is WRONG for Chroma
the Chroma text encoder is a T5-XXL file from comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders (fp16 recommended, fp8_scaled for less memory)
Chroma1-HD / Base / Flash decode with the FLUX autoencoder ae.safetensors (latent_format Flux)
Chroma1-Radiance generates in pixel space: 'No additional VAE is needed' - VAELoader must be the built-in 'pixel_space' option, not ae.safetensors
Radiance's 'latent' is a [B,3,H,W] pixel tensor from EmptyChromaRadianceLatentImage; EmptySD3LatentImage (16-ch) is the wrong shape
the official Radiance template patches the model with ChromaRadianceOptions (preserve_wrapper true, start_sigma 1, end_sigma 0, nerf_tile_size -1); without it tiling/speed cannot be tuned
Chroma's Flow Shift is 1.0 (creator-intended, 'greater detail'), raised at most to 3.0 for complex compositions
every official Chroma graph sets shift 1.0; the node default 1.73 is an AuraFlow value, not the creator's. Raise toward 3 only to fix a complex composition
official cfg is 3.0 (card) / 3.5 (template) / 3.8 (lodestones); community goes to 6-7; below 3 the negative stops working, far above 7 oversaturates
HD/Base/Radiance are full models: 26 (templates/lodestones) to 40 (card) steps; 8 steps is a Flash setting
Chroma1-Flash is 'the fast CFG baked version': community settings are cfg 1-1.5; running it at cfg 3.5 wastes the distillation (no official doc exists)
Flash: 8 steps with a second-order sampler (heun) or 16 with a multistep sampler (community)
both latent nodes take width/height in multiples of 16
the lodestones/Chroma v11..v50 checkpoints are 'DEPRECATED! use Chroma1-HD, Chroma1-Base or Chroma1-Flash instead'
the recipe's template needs at least this ComfyUI (HD 0.3.31, Radiance 0.3.60 - both below the pinned 0.35.0)

prompting.negative_default: This low quality greyscale unfinished sketch is inaccurate and flawed. The image is very blurred and lacks detail with excessive chromatic aberrations and artifacts. The image is overly saturated with excessive bloom. It has a toony aesthetic with bold outlines and flat colors.

negative_alternatives.radiance template: This low quality greyscale unfinished sketch is inaccurate and flawed. The image is very blurred and lacks detail with excessive chromatic aberrations and artifacts. The image is overly saturated with excessive bloom.
negative_alternatives.card (diffusers): low quality, ugly, unfinished, out of focus, deformed, disfigure, blurry, smudged, restricted palette, flat colors
negative_alternatives.lodestones workflow (opening): This greyscale unfinished sketch has bad proportions, is featureless and disfigured. It is a blurry ugly mess and with excessive gaussian blur. It is riddled with watermarks and signatures. Everything is smudged with leaking colors and nonsensical orientation of objects...

positive.line: Long natural-language captions - the encoder is T5-only (no CLIP tags); official examples end with photographic qualifiers: 'Amateur photography. Unfiltered. Real life. Natural light. Subtle shadows.' (template) / 'Amateur photography. unfiltered. natural lighting. anatomically correct.' (lodestones)

Card example: 'A high-fashion close-up portrait of a blonde woman in clear sunglasses. The image uses a bold teal and red color split for dramatic lighting. The background is a simple teal-green. The photo is sharp and well-composed, and is designed for viewing with anaglyph 3D glasses for optimal effect. It looks professionally done.'
Text rendering is demonstrated with a quoted title ('a title text that says "CHROMA1-HD" in a large white 3D letters'); extent beyond that NOT FOUND
The negative prompt is a full descriptive sentence in every official graph and it works (full-CFG model) - describe the failure mode, not a tag list
Trained on artistic, photographic, anime/furry and niche styles, 'fully uncensored, reintroducing missing anatomical concepts' - style words are followed literally

prompting.structure: one descriptive paragraph: shot type -> subject -> detail -> text (quoted) -> photographic/style qualifiers; negative as a sentence describing what a bad result looks like

hurts.line: very high cfg with shift 1 (community upper range 6-7)
Flash with cfg above ~1.5 or many steps

pitfalls.symptom: garbled or weak prompt following, load error on clip_l
pitfalls.fix: CLIPLoader type 'chroma' with a T5-XXL file only
shift 1.0; raise toward 3 only for complex compositions

pitfalls.symptom: missing-node / wrong model errors from an old guide
pitfalls.cause: deprecated lodestones/Chroma v-checkpoints or the old ComfyUI_FluxMod custom node
the model is WIP and upstream changes hourly
pitfalls.fix: pin the Comfy-Org chroma-radiance-x0 snapshot; enable force_sequential_txt_ids only for 2026-05-22..06-01 checkpoints lacking __sequential__
raise nerf_tile_size until OOM for speed; 0 disables tiling and 'may require a lot of VRAM'

pitfalls.symptom: Flash looks like a slow HD run
pitfalls.cause: cfg 3.5 / 26 steps on the CFG-baked checkpoint

pitfalls.symptom: fp8 file from lodestones' workflow not found
